Name: UtilityBelt
Author: Jared
Description: Utility Belt (early development): a future home for Quick Transfer, Repeat Action, Skill Speed Boost and new inventory and display utilities. This version includes Repeat Action, Quick Transfer and Skill Speed Boost (the last two need CSFF Mod Framework). Its own feature: Accessibility > Hide Rain And Snow Effects (off by default) hides the falling rain and snow while you are outside, leaving the weather, its sound and its effects on your character unchanged. Display > Clock Format (24-hour by default) can show the main clock as compact 12-hour (9:45p). Hotkeys > Cycle Equipped Containers (the backquote key) opens your worn bags one after another, and five optional keys (off by default) open one each. Hotkeys > Lock Toggle (L) locks the card under the pointer in an open container, with a small padlock on it, so the game's Take out all items button, Quick Transfer batches and Repeat Action runs leave it in place. Hotkeys > Sort Container (O) re-orders the open container: freshest first, then highest quality, then back to its earlier order, keeping locked cards in their slots. Display > Show Capacity And Warmth Readouts (off by default) adds one line to a card's Info tab: a container's weight (and, for a bowl or jar, liquid) against capacity in numbers, or a bed or cover's warmth while sleeping. Equipment > Quickswap When Equipping (off by default) makes equipping into a full slot swap with the worn card, which goes back where the new one came from. Display > Show Sealed Mark (off by default) draws a small red wax seal on a sealed storage pot or fermentation bin so it reads apart from an unsealed one. Character > Show Randomise Button (on, and it does nothing until pressed) adds a Randomise button to the character-creation perk screen that re-rolls your perks within the difficulty band you had, one per perk group, unlocked perks only, leaving skin, hair, eyes and the start place and season alone. RepeatAction > Auto-Pull Materials (off by default): when a Repeat Action run is refused because a card it needs in your hand (a Simple Arrow for the Composite Bow's Train) is in a chest or bag where you are, it takes one into your hand and tries again; locked cards, cards that cannot be moved by hand and other places are never touched. RepeatAction > Store Products In (off by default; hover a container and press Hotkeys > Pick Store Container, V): every card a Repeat Action run makes is moved into that container as each repeat finishes, stopping with a notice when it is full and forgotten when you change place. RepeatAction > Equip Spare Tool On Break (off by default): when a tool you wear for a repeated action breaks (worn Leather Gloves while harvesting nettles), it puts on a spare that does the same job from your hands, the ground or a container where you are, and the run carries on; locked cards and cards that cannot be moved by hand are never used. With Diagnostics > Log Module Sources on it logs which copy of each of the three included mods is running.
